title: Wheels Up Achieves Record Operational Milestone of Zero Cancellation Days
summary: Wheels Up Experience Inc. (NYSE: UP), a leading provider of on-demand private aviation, today announced a record breaking 74 days to-date in 2026 without a single flight cancellation (100% completion each day). This milestone exceeds 2025's annual count of zero cancellation days. "2025 was a record performance year for Wheels Up, and not five months into 2026, we're already beating our previous annual benchmarks," said George Mattson, Chief Executive Officer of Wheels Up. "Since day one, our mission has been to build the best-run private aviation company, and this latest proof point further demonstrates the progress we have made towards that goal. Having recently completed our fleet transition, we look forward to delivering even higher operational reliability."
